content:
I am delighted to share that I have successfully completed my Judicial Internship under Ms. Ariba Khan, Judicial Magistrate First Class (N.I. Act), Saket District Courts, New Delhi.

This internship has been an invaluable learning experience, providing me with practical exposure to the functioning of the judiciary, particularly proceedings under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881. Observing courtroom proceedings, understanding judicial reasoning, and witnessing the administration of justice firsthand has strengthened my interest in litigation and enhanced my understanding of procedural and substantive law.

I am deeply grateful to Ms. Ariba Khan Ma’am for her guidance, encouragement, and approachable nature throughout the internship. Her dedication, fairness, professionalism, and commitment to justice have been truly inspiring. She patiently shared her knowledge, encouraged learning through observation, and motivated me to develop a deeper understanding of the legal system. It was a privilege to learn under such an accomplished judicial officer.

I would also like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Advocate Sunil Kumar Sir for his constant support, mentorship, and encouragement. His guidance made this opportunity possible and greatly enriched my learning experience. His valuable insights, practical advice, and unwavering support have played a significant role in my professional growth, for which I am sincerely thankful.
